title: Amazonian ayahuasca as a technology for building relationships with beings

tellings.quote: the Amazonians who developed Iawaska for example, you know, this is a true pharmacological technology.

plain: A researcher named Andrew Gallimore, talking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says the peoples of the Amazon who developed ayahuasca, a traditional brewed drink that causes powerful visions, created what he calls "a true pharmacological technology." In the framing of the story, this drink is a tool for building relationships with beings met during the visions. If he is right, ancient Amazonian practice would be a deliberate method for making contact with other intelligences.
